articles.title: Madison Beer wins everyone over with her dance to celebrate a touchdown pass by Justin Herbert
articles.standfirst: Madison Beer steals the spotlight with her joyful reaction to Justin Herbert’s touchdown
articles.summary: Madison Beer steals the spotlight with her joyful reaction to Justin Herbert’s touchdown
articles.body:
Madison Beer gave Los Angeles Chargers fans something to smile about during an otherwise frustrating season opener, as cameras caught the singer enthusiastically celebrating fiancé Justin Herbert’s touchdown pass against the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.

Beer was watching from a suite at SoFi Stadium as the Chargers opened their 2026 NFL campaign against Arizona.

When Herbert connected with wide receiver Ladd McConkey for an eight-yard touchdown in the third quarter, the pop star immediately jumped to her feet, raised her arms and danced with a huge smile.

The CBS broadcast captured the spontaneous celebration, and the moment quickly spread across social media. A clip shared online drew plenty of attention, with fans reacting to Beer’s energetic display as she cheered for Herbert .

Beer was dressed in Chargers colors and wore a customized No. 10 jersey representing Herbert’s number. Her appearance showed how closely she has followed the quarterback’s football career since their relationship became public.

The celebration came at a crucial point in the game. Herbert’s touchdown pass to McConkey cut Arizona’s advantage to just two points and briefly appeared to give Los Angeles the momentum it needed to complete a comeback.

Madison Beer’s celebration goes viral despite Chargers loss

Unfortunately for Beer and the Chargers, the excitement didn’t last. Arizona responded strongly in the fourth quarter and eventually secured a 26-14 victory, handing Los Angeles a surprising home defeat to begin the season.

Herbert finished the afternoon with 209 passing yards, one touchdown and one interception. His fourth-quarter pick proved particularly costly, helping the Cardinals close out an upset that few expected before kickoff.

McConkey was one of Herbert’s key targets, finishing with five receptions for 82 yards and the touchdown. The Chargers also got a rushing touchdown from rookie Omarion Hampton , but their offense couldn't produce another touchdown after Herbert’s scoring connection with McConkey .

On the other side, Cardinals quarterback Jacoby Brissett threw for 277 yards and a touchdown, helping Arizona pull off one of the more unexpected results of the opening weekend.

While the Chargers' performance left fans disappointed, Beer’s celebration quickly became a separate talking point online. Social media users shared the clip of her jumping and dancing, with many joking about how happy she looked despite the eventual result.

Herbert and Beer made their relationship public in 2025, and the couple announced their engagement in July 2026. Beer has continued to support the quarterback, including by attending Chargers games and cheering him on from the stands.

Beer’s unfiltered excitement after Herbert found McConkey for the touchdown provided one of the afternoon’s most lighthearted scenes.

The Chargers will now look to regroup ahead of Week 2 after their unexpected loss. Herbert will be hoping for a stronger performance, while Beer’s enthusiastic presence could once again attract attention whenever the cameras turn toward the stands.

articles.title: Michael Irvin trolls Justin Herbert and fiancée Madison Beer after stunning loss
articles.standfirst: The Hall of Famer used Herbert’s relationship with Madison Beer to deliver a sharp postgame jab
articles.summary: The Hall of Famer used Herbert’s relationship with Madison Beer to deliver a sharp postgame jab
articles.body:
J ustin Herbert ’s relationship with Madison Beer became part of the conversation for all the wrong reasons after the Los Angeles Chargers suffered another ugly defeat.

Michael Irvin wasted little time piling on after the Chargers lost 26-14 to the Las Vegas Raiders at SoFi Stadium, using Herbert’s offseason travels with Beer to mock the quarterback’s inability to consistently move Los Angeles’ offense.

“You made the wrong drive,” Irvin said in a video posted to Instagram. “Driving your girl to the airport, but you can’t drive this team to that endzone?! That’s a problem.”

Irvin ’s social media team added another jab in the caption: “Mike thinks Justin Herbert is focused on the wrong drive.”

Los Angeles entered 2026 expecting a significant offensive improvement under new coordinator Mike McDaniel . Instead, the Chargers are 0-2 and Herbert has already found himself under growing scrutiny.

Herbert’s numbers reflect offensive struggles

Herbert finished the Raiders game 15-of-27 for 192 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions. He also fumbled three times as Las Vegas consistently disrupted the Chargers ’ rhythm and forced mistakes in key situations.

Through two games, Herbert has completed 59.3 percent of his passes for 401 yards, two touchdowns and three interceptions. His passer rating sits at 71.6, well below his career standards.

The Raiders added three sacks and nine quarterback hits, while rookie cornerback Hezekiah Masses intercepted Herbert twice. Los Angeles did not help its quarterback, either. False starts, protection issues and additional fumbles repeatedly stalled drives.

Irvin ’s criticism may have been delivered as a joke, but the broader concern around Herbert and the offense is becoming increasingly serious.

Analysts starting to question Los Angeles

Irvin wasn't the only former player to take aim at the Chargers after the loss. Will Compton admitted he had badly misjudged what McDaniel would bring to Los Angeles.

“The Chargers have been brutal,” Compton wrote.

Herbert ’s struggles have made him an obvious target because of his status as the franchise quarterback and the expectations that come with it.

His relationship with Beer has attracted attention away from football as well, particularly after the couple spent time traveling overseas during the offseason.

None of that has anything to do with the turnovers or protection problems on the field, but Irvin clearly saw an opportunity to connect the two.

The Chargers need Herbert to rediscover the form that made him one of the league’s most highly regarded young quarterbacks.

Until that happens, a winless start means every mistake, and every joke, is likely to receive even more attention.
